analysis:
Magnite surged 10.2%, outpacing the market by 14.6 points as SPY fell 4.4%. The coverage links the move to the company's Q3 earnings report released yesterday, with headlines noting analyst price target increases from Evercore ISI (raised to $33 from $25) and RBC (to $30 from $27), both maintaining positive ratings. One headline groups Magnite's surge with broader sector moves, mentioning AppLovin's 30% gain on strong results while Trade Desk fell 2%.

The stock reported yesterday after close, beating estimates by 16.9%, and its reaction shows a move beyond the market of 23.5 percentage points. Historically, this stock has moved significantly around earnings regardless of the beat or miss, with a typical abnormal move of around 12 points: it has beaten five times and missed three over the past eight reports, but two of those beats were followed by negative abnormal moves, so surpassing expectations hasn't consistently meant upside beyond what the market alone would explain.
